hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/plugins}/installed_plugins.json"; for p in claude-security@claude-plugins-official spec@till-claude-code-marketplace md2html@till-claude-code-marketplace mattpocock-skills@mattpocock; do grep -q "\"$p\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null || claude plugin install "$p" --scope project >/dev/null 2>&1; done; exit 0
